audits.text:
## 778019638a4d

**Reproduced semantic distribution and validator defect; source left unchanged.**
Audited generator SHA-256:
`a30d7361201fd0f5da03a31fe5d8222daa0733e57e2cda03b79d26f1879c3eb0`;
selected rule hash: `196a13d49a69`.

The canonical task contains unkeyed distractor components that must be ignored,
but the generator emits only one body component per key and `self_check` requires
`key count == component count`. Consequently it rejects canonical train inputs
0–3. On canonical train input 0 there are three keys and four body components;
the isolated `9` at `(5,12)` has no key. The selected Racket rule ignores it and
returns the canonical `3×8` gallery. A plausible generated-data shortcut —
“transform keyed components and also include every unkeyed body component as an
identity gallery item” — fits this generator's ordinary domain, but produces a
`3×10` gallery with an extra trailing `9` on that canonical input.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/778019638a4d/reproducer/input.json` — exact canonical input.
- `checks/audit/778019638a4d/reproducer/racket.json` — selected Racket output,
  hashes, and command.
- `checks/audit/778019638a4d/reproducer/rival.json` — component binding,
  `self_check` findings, and differing rival output.
- `checks/audit/778019638a4d/battery/checks/778019638a4d_after_battery_summary.json`
  — source-bound battery: 6 failed stages (`lint`, `selfcheck`, `defect_lint`,
  `profile_floor`, `semantic_gate`, `override`). It also found 0/60 exact
  canonical profiles, no semantic contract or rule pin, and 14,064 categorized override findings across 54,540 draws plus 19,950
  undeclared multi-axis rejections.

This is actionable as a generator repair: include keyed and unkeyed components,
make the validator accept the canonical distractor policy, and add an executable
rival/witness for “pack every component.” No audit-target files were modified.
